The Star Wars CCG Wiki is an independent fan project operated separately from Lucasfilm, Disney, and Decipher.

Volunteers maintain the wiki. Its information can be incomplete, out of date, or wrong. If you spot an error or an omission, you can correct it or raise it on the affected page's discussion page. See [[SWCCG Wiki:About#Corrections|Corrections]] for the wiki's process.

== Contact and takedown requests ==
